svg.title: Full pinout of the ZXpand+ extension connector mapped to a generic USB-serial TTL adapter
svg.desc: A 2 row by 5 column grid represents the ZXpand+ connector's 10 physical pins, numbered 1 to 10, top row odd-numbered and bottom row even-numbered. Three of the pins, GND, RX, and TX, are highlighted and connected with routed lines to a generic USB-serial adapter's GND, TXD, and RXD pins below. The remaining seven pins, Up, Fire, Down, 5V0, Left, Right, and 3V3, are shown in gray as unused for this purpose.
svg.text: Teal/blue = the 3 wires needed for serial loading · Gray = other connector pins, unused here
